ballPolicy: Leo’s basketball remains a separate runtime object. He disguises a backward pass, turns his shoulders and releases behind his hip toward image-left on frame3/tick5; no ball is painted into the poses.

cleanup.method: shared six-pose component isolation and nearest antialiased-pixel reassignment; 3x2 row-major atlas pack with common baseline

review.reviewNotes: Six distinct right-facing poses show a deceptive chest gather, shoulder turn, low behind-the-back release at frame3/tick5, follow-through and composed recovery. Leo remains a pale adult human with long wavy black hair, refined mustache, black/crimson kit and natural anatomy.
